name: Hotel filter
action: KPIs and every chart show only that hotel; the "Showing" line and an aria-live message update
keyboard: Tab to the group, arrow keys to change
reason: Natalia compares the city and the resort destination one at a time

name: Year filter
action: Same as I1 for the chosen year; partial years are named in the label
reason: Monthly report: focus on one season; labels avoid comparing partial years

name: Filters kept between screens
action: The link carries the filters (?hotel=...&year=...), so the other screen opens with them

name: Reset filters
action: Both hotels and all years; announced
reason: A safe way back (skills: reset always visible)

name: Linked month highlight
trigger: Pointer over a month, or arrow keys on the points of C1 or C3 and the cells of C2
action: A vertical rule marks the month in C1 and C3 and an outline marks its cells in the C2 heatmap; guests, cancellations and price of that month are written in the "Selected month" box
keyboard: Arrow keys move the month; Alt + up/down changes hotel
reason: Relate guests, cancellations and price of one month (Q1, Q5, Q7)

name: Tooltips
trigger: Pointer over a mark, or keyboard focus on a mark
action: Box with the exact formatted value and units
keyboard: Arrow keys on the marks; Escape hides the box
reason: Exact values without crowding the chart (architecture.md)

name: Select a country
trigger: Click a dot, bubble, box or country of the map; the list of countries; Previous / Next
action: The four charts and the KPIs show the selected country (band, bold label, bigger outlined dot, green bubble with its trail, striped box, outline on the map, name and values in the panel); a country of the list is added at the top of C4, C7 and C8 and as a bubble; no country is selected at first; a second click or "No country" clears it
keyboard: Arrow keys on the marks, Enter or Space selects or clears; Previous / Next (disabled at the ends); the list
reason: Q2, Q3, Q4, Q6 for one market; the default view shows all markets alike

name: Chart / Map switch
trigger: Two-option switch "Chart | Map" in the country box
action: The box shows the dumbbell (C4) or the map (C5); both share the selected country
keyboard: Tab to the switch, arrow keys
reason: The map stays one click away without adding a fourth chart (COGA)

name: Sort toggle
trigger: Radio buttons "By guests" / "A to Z" in the filter panel
action: The countries of C4, C7 and C8 are reordered; a country of the list stays at the top
reason: Find a known country quickly (A to Z) or see the ranking (by guests)

name: Play the year
trigger: Play / Pause button and a month slider under C9
action: The bubbles move from January to December, one month every 1.5 s, and stop at December; the slider shows any month; the month is written in the chart and announced
keyboard: Tab to Play and Enter or Space; arrow keys on the slider
reason: Q3: see how each market moves through the season; never starts by itself and can be paused (WCAG 2.2.2)

name: Table view
action: The chart is replaced by its data table, with the same filters; pressed again, the chart returns
reason: Exact values for screen readers and for copying (H8, H9)

name: Night mode
action: Dark page and charts with lighter Okabe-Ito colours; the choice is kept for the next visit
reason: Customisation for low vision (H18) and glare
